comment: How the page presents each release of the firmware: the name it goes by here, and a line about where it stands. A release that is not listed is shown by its own state on GitHub (verified, untested or draft). `pending` names what the page will list once its files are in a release.

release-2026-11-15.label: Alpha (portrait screen)
release-2026-11-15.note: Validated on a unit on 14 and 15 Nov 2026. If the Beta causes problems, flash this release.

release-2026-11-16-beta.label: Beta (Anubis, landscape screen)
release-2026-11-16-beta.note: The newest master firmware, with the landscape screen, and RF sensor builds for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C5 and the Waveshare ESP32-C5-Zero. They might contain bugs. For the Remote ID sensor, use the Alpha release.

rf-a2a45f2-ipex-zero.hardware: Waveshare ESP32-C5-Zero, antenna on its IPEX socket
notes: A measuring build for troubleshooting a demo, from a change that isn't merged yet. Its source code will be published later.
